description: Explore your Korzaro shop results in ChatGPT: sales, marketing, open findings, published briefings, SEO, mailing, reviews, competitors, social media and customer cohorts. Korzaro returns aggregate summaries for the one project and data areas approved by its owner. It cannot change the shop, campaigns or data.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my latest published briefing and the most important open findings.

What do SEO, mailing, reviews, competitors, social media and customer cohorts suggest I should examine next?
